entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.25510 Of 2023
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue any writ, order or direction more in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the action of respondent Nos.1 to 3 in not considering petitioner's representations dated 24.08.2020, 18.11.2020 and 13.12.2022 and demolishing part of petitioner's property bearing H.No.17-1-197/5/B/2, admeasuring to an extent of 120 Sq. yards situated at Madannapet, Dhobi Ghat, Hyderabad, without paying compensation and without initiating Land Acquisition proceedings in petitioner's name though her property to an extent of 25 Sq. yards out of 120 Sq. yards is acquired for road widening as illegal, arbitrary, unconstitutional and contrary to the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and consequently direct the respondent Nos.1 to 3 to forthwith consider petitioner's representations dated 24.08.2020, 18.11.2020 and 13.12.2022 and initiate Land Acquisition Proceedings in the name of petitioner and pay compensation to petitioner and further direct the respondent No.4 to not to disburse compensation of Rs.70,10,318/- deposited in L.A.O.P.No.206 of 2022 on the file of respondent No.4 to the respondent No.5 till the disposal of writ petition and pass..."
2.

Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Standing Counsel for GHMC and learned counsel appearing for the unofficial respondent No.6 and perused the entire material on record.

In view of the submissions made by the both sides, without going into the merits of the case, the writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondent Nos.1 to 3 to dispose of the representations filed by the petitioner dated 24.08.2020, 18.11.2020 and 13.12.2022 within four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

Till passing of the orders by the respondent Nos.1 to 3, the respondent No.4 is directed not to disburse the amount in L.A.O.P.No.206 of 2022 on the file of the respondent No.4-The Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Hyderabad.
